scope: Six-complex engineering pilot input representation only; not a full benchmark and not an assertion that model input exactly equals assay molecule.
preferred_system: Bcl-w fluorescence-anisotropy Kd, Foight et al. 2014 Table 2

assay_target.peptide: 23-aa peptide; N-terminal 5/6-fluorescein amidite (isomer mixture as reported); C-terminal amide. Do not substitute the N-acetyl/C-amide competition peptides because those yield Ki, not the direct Kd labels.
assay_target.receptor: human Bcl-w residues 1-164 with N-terminal c-myc tag after MBP/TEV purification; full c-myc/linker/TEV junction sequence is not recoverable from the cited methods and is left unknown.
assay_target.assay: direct fluorescence anisotropy, 25 C, 25 mM Tris pH 7.8, 50 mM NaCl, 1 mM EDTA, 0.001% Triton X-100, 5% DMSO; 2 h read after equilibration check.

proposed_structure_model_input.receptor_chain: UniProt Q92843 residues 1-164 only; omit c-myc/linker because its exact sequence is unavailable and it is a common terminal tag, while preserving this as an explicit assay-to-model mismatch.
proposed_structure_model_input.peptide_chain: standard 23-aa sequence only; record N-fluorescein and C-amide in metadata, but do not claim those chemical groups were structurally modeled.
proposed_structure_model_input.interpretation: Any structural scores are proxies evaluated against the labeled-peptide/c-myc-receptor assay Kd direction; they are not predictions of unlabeled-peptide Kd or complete binding free energy.

seed_policy.purpose: engineering feasibility and cross-seed stability only

entry_caveat: Mapping frozen for the limited engineering pilot before any new score. This is an explicit core-only proxy of the labeled assay system; it does not make the modeled molecule chemically identical to the assay molecule. Keep this mismatch attached to every result.
